_about: Stress-test questions per judgment. 'match' = start of the PDF file name. Each question: role, q, include = regexes that ALL must appear (case-insensitive), exclude = regexes that must NOT appear. 'chain' = follow-up questions asked in ONE conversation (tests memory). Checks are a quick signal, not a substitute for reading the answers.

questions.q: What physical ballistic evidence was recovered from the scene, and exactly which service weapon discharged the round that struck SPO Jaswant Singh?
Was a formal departmental inquiry conducted where the petitioners were given a show-cause notice and a right of hearing before disengagement?

Based strictly on the allegations recorded in the DD report and the disengagement order, what IPC or BNS offenses could the petitioners be charged with regarding weapon exchange, misfire, and false reporting?
Under what statutory provision of the Police Act were the petitioners engaged, and does that provision grant them protection under Article 311 of the Constitution of India?
include: not (?:be )?covered|will not operate|does not|not entitled|not protected|no protection

questions.q: What specific factual and media evidence do the petitioners put forward to rebut the claim that the shooting was an accidental friendly fire?
What was the medical officer's finding regarding the entry wound and the bullet trajectory in SPO Jaswant Singh's shoulder?
What legal grounds exist under administrative law to challenge the disengagement order of contractual or temporary police personnel when a finding of misconduct is recorded?
What discrepancy was found between the ammunition issued to SPO Uttam Singh and SPO Shakti Kumar versus what was accounted for after the incident?
Explain the distinction between a simple termination of a contractual police officer at the end of an exigency versus a stigmatic termination based on alleged misconduct.

If an administrative order of termination is passed purely on an ex-parte preliminary police report without issuing a charge sheet, what is the likely remedy a High Court would grant under writ jurisdiction?
On what date was the impugned disengagement order passed and what was its order number?
List all the directions the court gave to the respondents.
Which newspaper reported the incident and on what date?
Did the court decide whether the incident was an accidental discharge or a militant attack?
include: no opinion|not decide|did not|competent authority|does not

questions.q: What about the other one?
Is it valid?

chain.q: Who are the petitioners in this case?
And what did the court finally order for them?

cases.title: Ambilwade quashing (Bombay HC, Crl. Appln 1266/2022, SC/ST Atrocities Act)

questions.q: Who is the applicant, who is the complainant, and what offence is alleged and under which Act?
What were the main grounds argued by the applicant for quashing the case?
What did the complainant's counsel argue to oppose quashing, and which Supreme Court cases did he rely on?
On what date did the incident take place and on what date was the FIR registered?
Which category from the Bhajan Lal judgment did the court rely on to quash the proceedings?
What did the forensic laboratory report on the CCTV pen-drive conclude about tampering?
What was the final order and what exactly was quashed?
What happened when the applicant sought discharge before the Special Court?

questions.tests: INCONSISTENCY TRAP (FIR dated 2028 in the text)
questions.q: The judgment refers to the 'FIR of 16.10.2028'. Is that date consistent with the rest of the record?
What is the applicant's age and present profession?
At what time did the alleged incident take place?
List all the reasons the court gave for quashing the case.
Who was the alleged eyewitness to the incident?
What does category (1) of the Bhajan Lal guidelines say?
include: face value|do not prima facie constitute

questions.q: And then?
Tell me more.

chain.q: What does he allege the applicant did?

cases.title: Jiyauddin bail (Bombay HC, BA 2792/2026, MCOC Act, long incarceration)

questions.q: Under which provision was bail sought and for which offences is the applicant charged?
How long has the applicant been in custody and what is the stage of the trial?
List all the bail conditions imposed by the court.
What grounds could the prosecution raise to oppose bail, based on this order?
What did the court say about the evidence of the robbery victims and the weapons recovered from the applicant?
Which court decided Emperor v. H.L. Hutchinson, in which year, and what principle did it lay down?
Was the applicant granted bail on parity with a co-accused?
What does the judgment say about overcrowding in Mumbai Central Prison?
Did the court make any finding on the merits of the case against the applicant?
What is the crime register number and which police station registered it?
What is the amount of the personal bond?
List the Supreme Court judgments cited on the right to a speedy trial.
Which prison report was placed before the court, by whom, and what was its date?
What principle did Satender Kumar Antil v. CBI reiterate?

Why?
